hero.title: The AI assistant for your dental practice. 24/7. Multilingual.
hero.lead: Pantra replies on WhatsApp, books appointments, and cuts no-shows by 30%. In German, English, and 2 more languages of your choice.

how.heading: 30-minute setup. Results from day one.
how.step1_desc: Connect WhatsApp Business, sync your calendar, done. No technical configuration, no AI training required.
how.step2_desc: 24/7, in German, English, and 2 languages of your choice. Natural conversations, not robotic scripts.
how.step3_desc: A weekly report with bookings, inquiries, and recovered no-shows. Decisions backed by data, not gut feeling.

features.heading: What Pantra does for your practice.
features.card1_desc: Talk to patients in German, English, and 2 languages of your choice — Turkish, Arabic, Spanish, French, Russian, Italian, or Portuguese. Need an extra language? +€39/month.
features.card2_desc: A patient sends a voice message — Pantra understands it, transcribes it, and replies (with a voice message back too, if you like). Ideal for older and migrant patients.
features.card3_desc: Pantra books directly into Google Calendar or your practice management system (Dampsoft, CHARLY, Z1), confirming with the patient before every step.
features.card4_desc: Automatic reminders 48h, 24h, and 2h before the appointment. If a patient cancels, Pantra automatically offers the slot to the waitlist.

callout.heading: Built for German dental practices.
callout.text: GDPR-compliant. DPA included. Servers in Frankfurt. Pantra is compliance-ready from day one for the realities of German healthcare.

social.heading: Early access — 2026 pilot program.
social.placeholder_text: Through September 2026: Berlin dental practices are testing Pantra in our pilot program. The first video testimonials with real numbers will be published here soon.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions.
faq.a1: Yes. Pantra processes data under European law. We sign a data processing agreement with every practice before any data is processed. Servers in Frankfurt.
faq.a2: On servers in Frankfurt (AWS Frankfurt eu-central-1). Personal data is automatically redacted from logs and kept for a maximum of 7 days.
faq.q3: Which practice management systems are supported?
faq.a3: Dampsoft, CHARLY, and Z1 via webhook. Other systems integrate through Google Calendar as a fallback. If your system isn't on the list, just get in touch.
faq.a4: 30 minutes. We help you connect WhatsApp Business and your calendar. No technical knowledge required.
faq.q5: What happens if Pantra doesn't understand a question?
faq.a5: Pantra automatically escalates to your team via Telegram or email. You always have the final say — Pantra never makes medical or sensitive business decisions.
faq.a6: Yes. Cancel monthly with no lock-in (unless you choose the annual prepay plan). Your data is exported and deleted in accordance with GDPR.
faq.a7: Your practice's own number. We connect through Meta's official WhatsApp Business Cloud API — the number your patients already know stays exactly the same.
